INTERNSHIPS
Network Operations Intern, Golconda Netlink Pvt Ltd (ISP), Hyderabad | Jan 2026 - Mar 2026 (10 weeks)
- Watched link and device status on PRTG and raised alerts to the L2 engineer when a link went down.
- Troubleshot DHCP and DNS issues for 30 small business customers over phone and remote session.
- Found that a faulty patch cord was causing packet loss on a customer link by testing each segment.
- Updated the network diagram and the shift handover notes at the end of each shift.

IT Support Intern, Banjara Hills Hospital, Hyderabad | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Set up desktops and printers and crimped LAN cables for a new ward.

PROJECTS
- Campus network design: Configured VLANs, inter-VLAN routing and OSPF for a three-building campus in Cisco Packet Tracer.
- Wi-Fi survey: Measured signal strength across the college library and suggested access point positions.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- Cisco CCNA 200-301 (passed, 2025)
- Coursework: Computer Networks, Data Communication, Network Security

SKILLS
TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, Cisco Packet Tracer, PRTG, FortiGate firewall (basics), ServiceNow, Windows, Wireshark

ACTIVITIES
- Volunteer, technical team for the college fest network.
